verdict.rationale: Lambda exposes a raw OpenAPI 3.1 spec (cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json) and documents REST endpoints, but there is no evidence of an interactive, browsable API reference (e.g., Swagger UI, 'try it out' console) with runnable examples — probes for docs.lambda.ai/openapi.json, swagger.json, and llms.txt all 404.
